title: Skip the favors
example: Three couples and writers list favors as money guests forget.
basis: Saves whatever you planned for favors.

title: Trim decor, place cards and table numbers
example: One couple said table numbers and name cards took a lot of time for little effect.

title: Skip the vintage car
example: A vintage car shows up on the low-impact list from three couples and writers.
basis: Saves whatever you planned for wedding-day transportation.

title: Go simpler on invitations
example: Pricey invitations sit on the same low-impact list as favors.

title: Scale flowers down, or reuse ceremony flowers as centerpieces
example: Five write-ups say flowers cost far more than expected. Couples used silk flowers and wildflowers.

title: Swap the big cake for small desserts
example: One couple did a $240 macaron tower.
basis: The Knot cake range is $300 to $800. A $240 macaron tower (lesson 87) saves $60 to $560.

title: Borrow, buy second-hand or wear a family dress
example: Couples found a $76 dress, a second-hand designer dress at 64% off, and a mother's dress.

title: Ask a friend or relative to marry you
example: One couple had a relative as celebrant.

title: Skip the extra events
example: A planner's list of 50 ways to shrink a budget includes skipping extras.
basis: Saves whatever you planned for those events.

title: Move to a park, backyard or public venue
example: One state-owned venue had enough restrooms that the couple skipped renting a trailer.

title: Book a shorter photo session
example: Cheap photography cost one couple twice: a 25% cancellation fee, then a pricier replacement.

title: Use a playlist instead of a DJ
example: One couple used a free playlist. Others named shortened music as a regret.
basis: Saves whatever you planned for the DJ.

title: Skip the hair and makeup artist
example: Skipping an artist they loved was a named regret.

title: Rent cheaper chairs and seating
example: Cheap metal chairs saved one couple about $2,000 and they regretted it.

title: Serve less food or drink
example: One writer says food is not where to economize. Guests feel it all night.

title: Shrink the honeymoon
example: One couple traded cheaper chairs for a better honeymoon hotel.
